items.title: 双11前GUCCI全品类上线天猫旗舰店，与中国官网同步
items.summary: Ahead of China's Double 11 shopping festival, Gucci expanded its Tmall flagship store to around 3,000 seasonal products spanning apparel, watches, jewelry and home goods, now synced with its China official site. Tmall data showed over 70% of buyers were new to the store, with nearly half from tier-3-and-below cities; some first-time shoppers bought watches priced above 10,000 RMB immediately.

items.title: 古驰国内和国外价差有多大？实测最高省7000元，3个维度说清真相
items.summary: A Weibo post breaks down Gucci's China-vs-overseas price gap, citing classic styles priced 15-30% higher domestically (hot items over 40%), driven by tariffs/VAT (~20%), regional pricing strategy (~10%) and operating-cost differences (~5%); uses the Marmont mini bag (17,500 RMB in China vs ~13,000 RMB after EU tax refund) as an example and advises buying classics in Europe vs. boutiques domestically for service.

items.title: Has Gucci proved Made in China has a long way to go?
items.summary: Jing Daily examines the online divide over Demna's China-made Drip sneaker (~$1,000), questioning whether the move signals growing acceptance of Chinese luxury manufacturing or reinforces a reputational penalty; industry voices are split on whether perception has caught up with actual Chinese production capability.

items.title: 140만원짜리 구찌 신발에 붙은 '메이드인 차이나'…'중국산 명품' 통할까
items.summary: Korean coverage of Gucci's new China-manufactured Drip sneakers (1.4-1.6 million won), noting Gucci's statement that the shift is limited to select footwear and that Italy remains central to its identity; analysts quoted warn of tension between product origin and the luxury image Gucci is trying to rebuild, against a backdrop of a 50% three-year revenue decline and store closures.

items.title: 「グッチ」新作メンズスニーカーで中国製を明記
items.summary: Japanese trade press reports Gucci's Drip (820 euro) and a leather slip-on (750 euro) sneaker from the Primavera collection explicitly list China as country of manufacture on official e-commerce listings; Kering leadership reiterated the choice reflected required technical capability, not cost-cutting, and that Italy remains the core production hub.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: WWD Japan reports mixed industry reaction to Demna's runway debut FW2026-27 collection for Gucci (white bodycon mini dresses, bold red lips), citing Bernstein luxury analyst Luca Solca's score of 7.6/10 and noting the collection drew both praise and skepticism from trade observers.

items.title: 구찌지갑 짭인지 분간좀..
items.summary: A representative thread from DCInside's luxury board where users request help authenticating a Gucci wallet; recurring thread pattern on this board reflects ongoing community concern about counterfeit prevalence and durability/quality perception for Gucci leather goods relative to price.

items.title: "할머니 집 같아" 탄식…구찌 매장 '폐쇄 선언' 초유의 사태
items.summary: Korean business press reports Gucci plans to close around 125 stores globally by 2030 as part of a profitability overhaul, following Kering's prior closure of over 130 underperforming stores after a 13% group revenue decline; coverage includes consumer commentary mocking dated-feeling store design ("like grandma's house").

items.title: 古驰2026大换血：CEO换帅、降价40%、Demna首秀，现在还能买吗？
items.summary: Weibo explainer-style post synthesizes Gucci's 2026 upheaval for Chinese consumers: new CEO Francesca Bellettini, Demna's creative takeover, roughly 20-40% price cuts on bestsellers (GG Marmont, Ophidia), and about 75-100 global store closures; frames the central reader question as whether now is a rational time to buy given the brand repositioning.

items.title: 500만원짜리 '구찌'가 90만원…명품 '파격 떨이' 나선 이유
items.summary: Korean coverage of the collapsing secondhand/resale market for luxury goods including Gucci, where items once valued near 5 million won are reselling around 900,000 won; attributes the drop to eroded trust in resale platforms, wider availability of retail-price information via social media, and fatigue with resale markups during a higher-rate environment.

items.title: 【GUCCI（グッチ）】気分も新たに持ちたい新作カードケースやミニ財布が登場
items.summary: Japanese lifestyle media covers Gucci's newly launched small leather goods line (card cases, mini wallets) from the Primavera-era collection, spanning Horsebit, GG Marmont and Web stripe design codes, pitched as everyday accessible entry items for the brand.

items.title: 구찌 스니커즈가 메이드 인 차이나?…럭셔리 공급망 공식 '흔들'
items.summary: Korean trade press frames Gucci's Drip sneaker China-manufacturing disclosure as a potential crack in the long-standing luxury supply chain formula that leans on European provenance as a core value signal, situating it alongside broader questions about whether Chinese-made luxury can retain premium positioning.
